<?php

$lines = [
    'date,region,product,quantity,unit_price',
    '2026-04-01,north,notebook,10,200',
    '2026-04-01,east,marker,6,150',
    '2026-04-01,south,eraser,25,80',
    '2026-04-02,west,stapler,4,600',
    '2026-04-02,north,marker,8,150',
    '2026-04-02,east,notebook,9,200',
    '2026-04-03,south,stapler,3,600',
    '2026-04-03,west,eraser,15,80',
    '2026-04-03,north,eraser,20,80',
    '2026-04-04,east,stapler,5,600',
    '2026-04-04,south,notebook,6,200',
    '2026-04-04,west,marker,8,150',
];
$regions = $products = $days = [];
$total = 0;
foreach (array_slice($lines, 1) as $line) {
    [$date, $region, $product, $quantity, $price] = explode(',', $line);
    $quantity = (int) $quantity;
    $price = (int) $price;
    $amount = $quantity * $price;
    $total += $amount;
    $regions[$region] = ($regions[$region] ?? 0) + $amount;
    $products[$product] = ($products[$product] ?? 0) + $quantity;
    $days[$date] = ($days[$date] ?? 0) + $amount;
}
printf("total: %d\n", $total);
$regionNames = array_keys($regions);
usort($regionNames, fn($a, $b) => ($regions[$b] <=> $regions[$a]) ?: strcmp($a, $b));
foreach ($regionNames as $region) {
    printf("%s: %d\n", $region, $regions[$region]);
}
ksort($products, SORT_STRING);
foreach ($products as $product => $quantity) {
    printf("%s: %d\n", $product, $quantity);
}
$dates = array_keys($days);
usort($dates, fn($a, $b) => ($days[$b] <=> $days[$a]) ?: strcmp($a, $b));
printf("best day: %s (%d)\n", $dates[0], $days[$dates[0]]);
